_comment: 🧩️ This subset's own contribution. `s.trinity.jack` is a semio-NATIVE assembly scene: a labelled property graph whose edges address PORTS over a kind manifest. No graph library models a port-addressed endpoint and none reads `.dsl.semio`, so the reference is a SECOND IMPLEMENTATION in Python written from this subset's committed snapshot schema, mutation grammar and specification vectors.

oracles.rationale:
A second implementation of the `s.trinity.jack` scene, of its `.dsl.semio` carrier and of all eight typed mutations, in Python, at `../../../../../🧪️tests/mutate-jack-1/🐍️component.py`. Written from `../🧬️schema/📸️snapshot/🔣️.json` (the document: nodes with ports, edges over `node@port` endpoints, a manifest, a camera and a root node id), `../🧬️schema/🧬️mutations/📝️text/📖️.grammar.semio` (the eight verbs and their positional argument lists) and the eight committed specification vectors. It imports nothing from this repository and transliterates none of its Rust. A third-party library was declined, not merely absent: `networkx`, `igraph` and `petgraph` model vertices and edges but have no notion of a PORT-addressed endpoint, of a manifest that closes the kind vocabulary, or of the untyped property bag `change-data-property` and `remove-data-property` edit, and none of them reads this carrier. THREE FINDINGS reported rather than worked around: (1) `../🧬️schema/🧬️mutations/🔣️.json` does not describe the mutations — it is a verbatim copy of the snapshot schema with the title changed — so the wire form was read off the vectors, which inconsistently mix camelCase discriminators with snake_case arguments; (2) nothing states whether deleting a node cascades to its edges, so the reference cascades on the grounds of the invariant `create-edge`'s own rejection establishes, and the feature's `delete-node` row addresses a node no edge names so the comparison never rests on the inference; (3) all eight committed vectors are NEGATIVE, three rejections and five accepted no-ops, so the accepting direction of this vocabulary had no committed evidence before this case's real-document scenarios. `package` is deliberately empty: the implementation needs no distribution, so this entry contributes nothing to `🔒️dependencies.json`.

UNDER PROTOCOL V2 this registration is classified `cross-semio-implementation` — a required SUPPLEMENTAL oracle that does not discharge `jack-1-mutate`'s external-oracle requirement for its 8-kind mutation vocabulary; a qualifying third-party reference (`third-party-library` / `third-party-cli` / `standards-reference-tool`) is still owed.
